package continuation
namespace continuation
entity Integer id "continuation://integer"
entity Box id "continuation://box" fields {
    field value id "continuation://box/value" type integer required one
}
activity Seed(Integer) -> Box computes "return Box{value: (input + 1)}" assembling {
    baseline "return Box{value: input}"
    picked "value" -> "value_second"
    choice "value" field_value at "0" alternative "input + 1" intent "Add one to the input."
    value_case "[1]" -> "{\"value\":2}"
    value_case "[2]" -> "{\"value\":3}"
    attempts "2"
}
activity Wrap(Integer) -> Box computes "let next = Seed(input); return Box{value: next.value}" assembling {
    choice "value" field_value at "0" alternative "next.value * 2" intent "Double the incremented input."
    value_case "[1]" -> "{\"value\":4}"
    value_case "[2]" -> "{\"value\":6}"
    attempts "2"
}
activity Main(Integer) -> Integer computes "let left = Wrap(input); let right = Wrap(input + 1); return left.value + right.value"
